purpose: Local reference orchestrator. The CLI initializes workspaces, accepts inputs, calls package APIs in order, persists workflow artifacts, asks questions, shows reports, invokes render/export, and enforces checkpoints without duplicating domain ownership.

public_api.style: main(argv=None, cwd=None, stdin=None, stdout=None, stderr=None) returns a command result or process-style integer exit code. Commands may be synchronous or asynchronous behind the public entrypoint.

commands.name: init
commands.description: Create the workspace, write valid default config, prepare/migrate career-store database through career-store APIs, record versions, and safely tolerate reruns.

commands.name: ingest_resume
commands.description: Accept a resume fixture, call core validation/sanitation, persist base and working artifacts, record base hash, and persist candidate career facts through career-store.

commands.name: ingest_job
commands.description: Accept a job description as an existing file path, http(s) URL, or pasted text; call agent extraction and core job normalization; retain source text; classify requirement types; and persist job/current.json.

commands.name: match
commands.description: Run official scoring through resume-core, search career facts through store/MCP, emit deterministic requirement-level reasoning, and route hard unresolved requirements to resolution policy.

commands.name: resolve
commands.description: Use resume-core unresolved-topic selection, agent phrasing only, structured answer interpretation, career-store persistence after explicit confirmation, and match reruns.

commands.name: tailor
commands.description: Build deterministic selection plan, invoke agent rewrite proposals, persist operations separately, validate through core, apply only valid operations to working resume, and audit rejections.

commands.name: validate
commands.description: Run final match, grounding audit, ATS checks, structure/length checks, repetition checks, inferred-fact rejection, and unresolved-requirement truth checks.

commands.name: export
commands.description: Invoke renderer, write Markdown and DOCX targets, record template version, handle overflow by returning to selection/rewrite, and run render validation.

commands.name: run
commands.description: Execute the same checkpoint sequence as individual commands and produce equivalent artifacts for equivalent state/config.

commands.name: inspect_fact
commands.description: Show fact, verification state, evidence, relationships, and conflicts through store/MCP public APIs.

commands.name: inspect_requirement
commands.description: Show requirement source text, normalized terms, resolution state, and evidence through core/workflow public reports.

commands.name: audit
commands.description: Reconstruct run identity, config hash, versions, scores, questions, facts, operations, validations, and outputs from workflow/report artifacts.
